text: La revolución digital en el Código Civil peruano identifies normative challenges from integrating smart contracts into Peruvian civil law and calls for explicit legislative recognition. This independently corresponds to Kaal's claim that legal frameworks must adapt to growing smart-contract use. The abstract does not specify which reforms are sufficient and does not generalize beyond Peru.
